title: Comparative study on the interaction of three cationic cycloplatinated(II) complexes with DNA and HSA.
authors: Nikfard, Somayeh; Mohammadi, Fakhrossadat; Shahsavari, Hamid R
one_liner_zh: 该文研究三种环金属铂配合物与DNA及HSA的相互作用，涉及DNA结合机制和分子对接，但对象为小分子-核酸互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且方法以实验为主、对接为辅，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: The biomolecular interactions of three previously reported cationic cycloplatinated complexes, [Pt(dfppy)(dppm)]Cl, C1, [Pt(dfppy)(dppe)]Cl, C2, and [Pt(dfppy)(dppbz)]Cl, C3, (dfppy = 2-(2,4-difluorophenyl)pyridine; dppm = bis(diphenylphosphino)methane; dppe = 1,2-bis(diphenylphosphino)ethane; dppbz = 1,2-bis(diphenylphosphino)benzene) with calf thymus DNA (ctDNA) and human serum albumin (HSA) have been investigated. The competitive behavior of the Pt complexes with four different fluorescent probes displayed multiple DNA binding mechanisms, including both intercalation and minor groove binding. The negative values of DeltaH degrees  and DeltaS degrees  suggested that van der Waals and hydrogen bonding are the predominant forces in the interactions of C1 and C2 with DNA. The sign of DeltaH degrees  and DeltaS degrees  changes at 298 K for interaction of C3 with DNA from negative to positive. Also, the binding of C3 to DNA occurs with the highest affinity compared to C1 and C2. The positive values of DeltaH degrees  and DeltaS degrees  revealed that hydrophobic interactions were the main force in the binding of the Pt complexes to HSA. Experimental results and docking investigations showed that the binding sites of HSA for C1, C2, and C3 are mainly located in the subdomain IIA (site I). The results of molecular docking investigations demonstrated that pi-pi-stacking and hydrophobic interactions are involved upon HSA binding of these complexes.
abstract_zh: 已对三种先前报道的阳离子环铂配合物[Pt(dfppy)(dppm)]Cl、C1、[Pt(dfppy)(dppe)]Cl、C2和[Pt(dfppy)(dppbz)]Cl、C3（其中dfppy = 2-(2,4-二氟苯基)吡啶；dppm = 双(二苯基膦)甲烷；dppe = 1,2-双(二苯基膦)乙烷；dppbz = 1,2-双(二苯基膦)苯）与小牛胸腺DNA（ctDNA）和人血清白蛋白（HSA）的生物分子相互作用进行了研究。这些Pt配合物与四种不同荧光探针的竞争行为显示了多种DNA结合机制，包括嵌入和次要沟槽结合。DeltaH度 和DeltaS度 的负值表明，范德华力和氢键是C1和C2与DNA相互作用中的主要作用力。在298 K下，C3与DNA相互作用的DeltaH度 和DeltaS度 的符号由负变为正。此外，与C1和C2相比，C3与DNA的结合具有最高的亲和力。DeltaH度 和DeltaS度 的正值揭示了疏水相互作用是Pt配合物与HSA结合中的主要作用力。实验结果和对接研究表明，HSA对C1、C2和C3的结合位点主要位于亚结构域IIA（位点I）。分子对接研究结果表明，这些配合物与HSA结合时涉及pi-pi堆积和疏水相互作用。
